zookeeper.connections: The total count of client connections.
zookeeper.datadog_client_exception: The exception rate seen by the Datadog Agent when trying to collect stats.
zookeeper.latency.avg: The amount of time it takes for the server to respond to a client request.
zookeeper.latency.max: The amount of time it takes for the server to respond to a client request.
zookeeper.latency.min: The amount of time it takes for the server to respond to a client request.
zookeeper.nodes: The number of znodes in the ZooKeeper namespace (the data).
zookeeper.outstanding_requests: The number of queued requests when the server is under load and is receiving more sustained requests than it can process.
zookeeper.timeouts: The rate of timeouts the Datadog Agent received when trying to collect stats.
